**1082 hits across 94 files.** Three zones must not change.

| Zone | Files | Do |
|---|---|---|
| `services/*` JS | 75 | Rename |
| [`docs/openapi.yaml`](docs/openapi.yaml), [`lib/serialize.js:8`](lib/serialize.js:8) | 2 | Freeze |
| [`vendor/reporting-sdk/`](vendor/reporting-sdk/README.md) | 4 | Freeze |
| `migrations/*.sql` | 12 | Freeze |

`account_id` is the public API field name. Vendor files get overwritten by `npm run vendor:refresh`. Applied migrations are history.

One trap in the safe zone. Repo SQL strings name the real column. Keep those strings until a new migration renames it.

Sign off on the `services/*` rename only.
